title: Nick Sirianni Press Conference: September 24, 2026
headline: Saquon Barkley's status is unclear pending the injury report, Zach Ertz has not practiced yet, and Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley remain a trusted running back committee.
summary: Sirianni said the Bears are a strong, well-coached team and that the quarterback uncertainty is just another layer of weekly planning. He called the Eagles' 2026 season a process, with pads practice once a week, and emphasized block destruction and run defense as keys to this game. On takeaways, he said the team has had few real chances, since the opposing QBs have been mobile, and he stressed that tackling comes before strip attempts. He said Zach Ertz has not practiced yet and that trust is built through reps, so his readiness for Sunday will be determined at practice. On Saquon Barkley, he deferred to the injury report and said Barkley works hard to be ready each week. He praised Kenny Moore's competitiveness and said his versatility could let him contribute at safety, though it still needs to be seen in practice. He described Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley as a trusted committee at running back, both having earned reps, and he credited the depth after Barkley left a game. He also praised rookie Dontayvion Wicks's physicality, contested catching, and work ethic, saying the team saw his potential on tape before drafting him.
